No other callers show errors against currencyservice, but frontend's own error rate is 75.1%, consistent with relayed errors from currencyservice.
The call volume is only 47% of baseline, so missing edges are likely due to low traffic, not faults.
No CPU throttling is observed on any service, so resource exhaustion is unlikely.

Therefore, the root cause is currencyservice being unreachable due to a configuration error in frontend.
The fault propagates from currencyservice failure to frontend errors.
